[[File:rubberduckbox.png|thumb|A [[cargo container/Legends|container]] with 1 [[metric ton/Legends|ton]] of rubber ducks stored in [[Ramsees Hed]].]]
'''Rubber''' was any type of material with the mechanical or material property that could undergo much more elastic deformation under stress than most materials and still return to its previous size without permanent deformation. Rubber was normally used to make [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] there were several [[cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] in the warehouses of [[Ramsees Hed]], bearing the [[Alliance Starbird]], marked with [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic letters]] that they contained each a [[Metric_ton/Legends|ton]] of "rubber [[duck/Legends|ducks]]".<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>
